text: Stepping from the quiet orderliness of a glass-walled meeting room into the vibrant and cerebral display of R+D, I feel a palpable shift—from the controlled energy of collaboration to the boundless curiosity of innovation. The juxtaposition of these two spaces—one gleaming with potential decisions, the other brimming with inquiry—reminds me how the human spirit oscillates between discipline and wonder. There is a restlessness in me here, a desire to cross the threshold and dive into conversation, invention, and the unknown. I feel small in the face of these big ideas, yet somehow more alive, more awake to possibilities.
